ORDER SUSTAINING DEMURRER OR IN THE ALTERNATIVE GRANTING MOTION TO STRIKE.

DEMURRER SUSTAINED WITHOUT LEAVE TO AMEND ON THE GROUNG THAT ANY ACTION FOR BREACH OF SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT MUST BE BROUGHT SEPARATELY.IT IS FURTHER ORDERED THAT THE MOTION TO STRIKE BE, AND IS HEREBY, GRANTED AND THAT THE FIRST AMENDED COMPLAINT BE, AND HEREBY IS STICKEN.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MITCHELL ENGINEERING/OBAYASHI CORPORATION, JOINT VENTURE TAKE NOTHING FROM DEFENDANT TRANS BAY STEEL CORPORATION TRANS BAY STEEL CORP., IS HEREBY DISMISSED SUBJECT TO THE COURT'S RESERVATION OF JURISDICTION TO ENFORCE THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT PURSUANT TO CCP 664.6 & 664.7.THAT THIS COURT SHALL REATIN JURISDICTION OVER THIS MATTER PURSUANT TO CCP SEC. 664.6 FOR PURPOSES OF ENFORCING THE PARTIES WRITTEN SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.
MOTION TO ENTER JUDGMENT PURSUANT TO WRITTEN SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT (CCP SECTION 664.6).TRANS BAY STEEL CORPORATION IS HEREBY DISMISSED.
